hook: An Ethiopian saved the prophet Jeremiah's life.

verse.translation: “…you will escape with your life; because you have put your trust in me,” says Yahweh.

story: Jeremiah warned Jerusalem it would fall. For that, the city's officials lowered him into a pit with no water, only mud, and he sank into it.
Ebedmelech, an Ethiopian serving in the king's palace, went to the king and spoke up. With thirty men, he let down old rags on ropes so the cords wouldn't cut Jeremiah, and pulled him out.
When Jerusalem fell, God sent Jeremiah with a message for Ebedmelech: he would be spared, because he trusted God.
meaning: This fast is named for the prophets. Jeremiah lived to keep prophesying because one Ethiopian refused to stay quiet.

sources.title: Jeremiah 38:1–13 and 39:15–18, World English Bible (public domain)
